_about: Captions for the Overnight page (pages/overnight.html), one per screen, in page order. Each id must be a Destinations id; the images are the CI screenshots the site already publishes. Written from the night's status pages and the screenshots of screens run 16.

screens.title: My day
screens.text: Opens on you: the next stand-up with a link to your briefing, what starts in the next three hours, what only you can do, decisions, overdue and due-soon items, and what your agents did.
screens.note: The iPad sidebar has ten sections. The iPhone has four tabs and More.

screens.title: The team
screens.text: Everyone's load from the board: what only they can do, what waits on their decision, what is late, and who needs help. Sort by attention, name or level, and see each person's next stand-up.

screens.title: What the agents are doing
screens.text: Every newsroom agent: when it fired, how each wake went, and what it is asking a person for. The 24-hour wake grid is redrawn natively from the team site's data.

screens.title: Your briefing
screens.text: The stand-up briefing, the decisions waiting on you, what the agents ask, the newsletters, and links to the web versions of each brief.
screens.note: In the CI run the command-centre panel could not load and says so. Worth a check on a real device.

screens.title: The news, in every form
screens.text: PrompTugal.news as a native reader: the feed, the morning and evening editions, and the stories being made.

screens.title: How the news is made
screens.text: Every story from idea to published, the desks that feed them, the research-to-front-page pipeline, and what is blocked on a person.

screens.title: The whole graph, drawn on the device
screens.text: The newsroom's knowledge graph in five worlds: the summit programme, the people, the industry, the evidence and the newsroom. About 1,700 nodes and 2,900 edges, with zoom.
screens.note: The screenshots caught a real bug here: the graph showed "unavailable" on real data until its decoding was fixed.

screens.title: The agenda
screens.text: Every session in Lisbon time, by day, with a star to add it to the schedule you share with promptugal.news, and a filter for your picks only.
screens.note: The screenshot tests found this screen too slow for accessibility with the full agenda. It was rebuilt overnight: one element per row for VoiceOver, filtering done once per change.

screens.title: What ran, and what is read
screens.text: Agent wakes by hour, activity per person, runs by day and desk runs, drawn with Swift Charts from the public JSON, plus the health of every endpoint the app reads.
screens.note: Reader traffic is sealed in a write-only vault lane. The screen says so.

screens.title: Your vault on the phone
screens.text: Paste or scan a team key, or use a recovery code. Keys stay on the device, in the Keychain behind Face ID, and are never shown or logged. The Swift reader and writer are proven against vaults written by the vault command-line tool.

screens.title: How the app works
screens.text: Every request, every vault object and its decryption steps, every bridge message, what is stored, and which keys exist. Never a key's value. "Native and web" counts how many screens are native.

screens.title: Settings
screens.text: Who you are on the team, which picks the command centre, briefing and counts the app shows you. Debug mode, which adds a native, web or hybrid badge to every screen. The version and build.

screens.title: The Wall
screens.text: The team, where the agents fired in the last 24 hours, the pipeline, the newsroom's latest runs and the next stand-up as a countdown, for an iPad on a stand at the event. It refreshes itself and says when it is offline.
